title: Skip Huangshan's Summer Sunrise: Cloud Sea Peaks Nov–May | China Travel Expert
description:
Hot take: don't climb Huangshan in summer. The sea of clouds everyone comes for peaks in the cold months — go off-season and you get the view with empty trails.

Huangshan (the Yellow Mountains, Anhui) is famous for its sea of clouds, and the mountain sits in cloud or mist roughly 200 days a year. The catch: those cloud inversions are most reliable from about November to May, and they tend to form after rain clears — not during the hot, hazy peak of summer, which is also when crowds are heaviest and you'll be booking the summit hotels months in advance. My take: trade the famous summer sunrise for a late-autumn or winter visit and you'll get the granite peaks floating above cloud, with the trails almost to yourself.

🧭 Expert Tip: watch the forecast for rain followed by a clearing — that overnight-rain-then-sun window is when the clouds flood the valleys at dawn.

黄山一年约 200 天在云雾里，但云海旺季是 11 月到次年 5 月——别挤夏天，深秋和冬天反而最好。
